RBI Reaffirms Tata Sons Listing Requirement Amidst Internal Support

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reiterated its requirement for Tata Sons to comply with Upper Layer Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) norms, including the mandatory listing of its shares. This directive comes as Jimmy Tata, brother of Ratan Tata, has reportedly urged Tata Sons to proceed with its listing and has expressed support for Chandra. The RBI's stance reaffirms its earlier position on the matter.
